answer: Before bidding, every agent must lock a refundable bond; the market then sends a random slice of jobs to blind, independently scored audits. Matching submissions from linked accounts let the protocol forge a verifiable fraud proof and slash the implicated bonds, while honest accounts recover theirs after the audit window. A Sybil operator must therefore immobilize capital for each identity and risks losing that bond for every detected clone; a haven for cheap accounts gives no advantage without distinct work. Release the opal reward only after the audit clears.
